Respondents
 Prayer:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o
 for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directing the second respondent
 appropriate orders on the reference/representation dated 29.11.2022
 by the petitioner, by appointing competent Engineers/Officials for 
 the value of the structure and amenities in Petroleum Bunk etc., co
 in S.No.447 and hence and pay appropriate compensation to the petit
 by reconsidering the Awards dated 17.08.2021 by strictly following 
 procedure contemplated under Sections 26 to 30 of Right to Fair
 Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation a
 Resettlement Act, 2013 (Central Act 30 of 2013) and re-fix the
 compensation as per the provision of Schedule I and Ii and Section 
 and b of the Central Act 30 of 2013.
 For Petitioner : Mr.M.Selvam

sentences.text: 4. The learned Additional Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents 2 and 3 brought to the notice of this Court that the District Collector has already decided the issues regarding enhancement of compensation and therefore, the petitioner has to prefer an appeal before the jurisdictional Principal District Judge for adjudication of issues.
Thus the petitioner is at liberty to file an appeal before the concerned Principal https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis District Judge for enhancement of compensation or otherwise.
5. With the above liberty, the writ petition stands disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
